title: Laurel Over Iron
description: Marble Law, Iron Oath: Laurel Over Iron unfolds across floating marble arena edge connected to storm bridge anchors, with broken terraces and bronze judgment rails, pushing the one active deity Asgardian deity to convert endurance into decisive counterpressure. Appearance rule: Storm-Rooted Aesir Holds is the source culture humans later copied as Norse saga myth; mission terrain and cosmetics must show rune iron, stormsteel, oath rings, raven omens, wolf teeth, Yggdrasil roots, frost-bitten leather, blackwinter scars.
lore: This mission treats Storm-Rooted Aesir Holds as the origin behind Norse saga myth: battlefield architecture, reward cosmetics, relic props, and hazard silhouettes must use rune iron, stormsteel, oath rings, raven omens, wolf teeth, Yggdrasil roots, frost-bitten leather, blackwinter scars instead of generic historical or RPG dressing.
terrain: floating marble arena edge connected to storm bridge anchors, with broken terraces and bronze judgment rails; source-culture appearance layer: rune-storm bridges, oath-stone courts, Bifrost storm fractures, Yggdrasil root ramps, Valhalla shieldwall ruins; cosmetic/relic silhouettes: rune-iron oath axes, stormsteel wolf-cloak mail, Yggdrasil thunder-root cores, Valkyrie witness counters

objectives.primary: Complete Laurel Over Iron with one active deity while reading floating marble arena edge connected to storm bridge anchors, with broken terraces and bronze judgment rails and preserving faction doctrine.
optional: Keep at least four Titan standing
Trigger at least two Oathbound counterattacks
Trigger at least one Momentum or Divinity decision before victory

specialRules: Storm Oath: Momentum surges after decisive movement through exposed lightning lanes.
Trial Terms: optional objectives change rewards but never overwrite faction identity.
Oathbound: surviving damage strengthens the next committed strike.
Solo Deityic Scale: one active deity occupies the tactical focus; enemies, elites, and bosses scale around that single presence.
victoryConditions: Complete Laurel Over Iron with one active deity while reading floating marble arena edge connected to storm bridge anchors, with broken terraces and bronze judgment rails and preserving faction doctrine.
